text:
Predicates:
InfectiousDisease(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
Feel(x, y) ::: x feels y.
Get(x, y) ::: x gets y.
Premises:
InfectiousDisease(monkeypox) ∧ CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, animal) ∧ OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, human) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Human(human) ∧ Mammal(human) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(mammal) → Animal(mammal) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(fever, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(headache, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(musclePains, monkeypox) ∧ Symptom(tired, monkeypox) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
∀x (Get(x, glu) → Feel(x, tired)) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
Symptom(coughing, monkeypox) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include coughing.
